pages.text: High water widened the river. The three children stood on the embankment at the yard's edge. Far below was the river; strong wind blew.
Raju gripped the kite string in both hands. "My kite will go highest!"
Sonu reached out. "I want to hold it." Raju answered sharply, "You're not ready yet."
Raju's kite rose and rose. Mina's rose beside it.
The wind strengthened. Raju's arms jerked forward.
The string slipped out. The kite flew away by itself.
It caught in a tree across the river. Raju stood empty-handed.
Mom opened Raju's hand and Sonu's side by side.
Mina offered their own string for all three to hold: Raju's hand on top, Mina's in the middle, Sonu's at the bottom.
The kite held by three rose much higher than before. Sonu shouted, "We're highest!"
